title: Gon steals Hisoka's badge, gets robbed by another hunter, then Hisoka steps in

cuts.voiceover_text: Under cover of night, Gon quietly tails Hisoka through the forest, watching him from the shadows, waiting for his shot at Hisoka's badge.
Later, Hisoka finds his real target, a swordsman marked with badge number forty-four, and lunges at him. Hidden nearby, Gon tenses, gripping his fishing rod, ready to make his move.
Hisoka cuts the swordsman down without breaking stride. In the chaos of the kill, Gon casts his rod, hooks the badge right off Hisoka's chest, and yanks it free.
Gon sprints off through the trees, badge in hand, thrilled that his plan actually worked.
But another hunter has been waiting for Gon this whole time. He shoots Gon with a paralyzing dart, drops him to the ground, and digs through his backpack to take Gon's own badge for himself.
The hunter kneels over the paralyzed Gon and gloats, holding up his own badge alongside the one he just stole.
Before he can walk away, a shadow strikes him down. Hisoka has caught up, and the hunter never sees it coming.
Hisoka returns to Gon's side, holding both recovered badges, praising how well Gon hid himself and timed his strike.
He carries the still-paralyzed Gon through the forest and sets him down right next to the hunter's body, leaving both badges behind with him.

Once Gon recovers, he corners Hisoka, badge pinned to his chest, refusing to owe him anything. He demands Hisoka take it back, but Hisoka refuses, telling Gon he'll only accept it once Gon can punch him in the face like that himself.
Knocked out and alone in the dark forest, Gon is left to process just how outmatched he really was.
